items.q: The life after death is called this.
The world of things beyond our senses, known only through revelation.
The garden of reward in the Hereafter.
The place of punishment in the Hereafter.
The life between death and the Day of Resurrection.
The Day when the dead are raised.
The Trumpet blown at the end of the world.
The scale on which deeds are weighed.
The bridge over Hell that all must cross.
The record of deeds handed to each person.
The believers receive their record in this hand.
The beings created from smokeless fire.
The jinn who refused to bow to Adam (عليه السلام).
The angels were created from this.
The false messiah who will appear before the end.
The Prophet who will return near the end of time.
The signs that the Hour is near are called this.
The Day of Judgement will begin after the Trumpet is blown this many times, by the common view.
Only Allah knows when this will come.
The highest level of Paradise, which our Beloved Prophet ﷺ told us to ask for (paraphrased).
"Every soul shall taste" this (meaning).
The angel who takes souls at death.
The noble writers who record our deeds.
The Pond of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ on the Day of Judgement.
Pleading on someone's behalf on the Day, by Allah's leave.
Paradise has rivers of water, milk, pure drink and this, says Surah Muhammad.
The people of Paradise will wear clothes of this.
Paradise is as wide as these, says Surah Al 'Imran.
"Master of the Day of" this, says al-Fatihah (meaning).
The fuel of the Fire is people and these.
The angel who keeps the Fire, named in Surah al-Zukhruf.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said: visit graves, for they remind you of this.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said one whose last words are this will enter Paradise.
The pure companions of Paradise, with beautiful eyes.
The angels who question the dead in the grave.
The three questions in the grave are about one's Lord, religion and this.
The Day of Resurrection is described as lasting this many years in Surah al-Ma'arij.
The sun will rise from this direction as a major sign.
The two nations who will break through the barrier near the end.
The ruler who built the barrier against Ya'juj and Ma'juj.
The beast that will speak to people as a major sign.
The guided leader from our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ family who will rule with justice.
'Isa (عليه السلام) will descend near this white minaret in the east of a city.
'Isa (عليه السلام) will kill the Dajjal at this gate.
The Dajjal is blind in this eye.
The surah whose first ten verses protect from the Dajjal (paraphrased).
The gate of Paradise for those who fast.
The number of gates of Paradise.
The number of gates of Hell.
The river in Paradise given to our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The tree in Hell whose fruit is like the heads of devils.
The wall between Paradise and Hell, and the name of a surah.
The day of gathering all of creation is called this.
The greatest joy of the people of Paradise will be this.
Surah al-Waqi'ah divides people into three: the foremost, the companions of the right, and these.
The number of keepers set over Saqar.
The boiling water given to the people of the Fire.
Whoever drinks from our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ Pond will never do this again.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said worldly fire is one part of this many parts of the heat of Hell.
The Sirat is thinner than a hair and sharper than this.
Between the Dajjal's eyes this word is written, which every believer can read.
Among the signs of the Hour: barefoot, poor shepherds competing in this.
Knowledge will be taken away, not snatched from people, but by the death of these.
Allah accepts a servant's repentance until his soul reaches this.
"Deeds are judged by" these, our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said (meaning).
Whoever has faith the weight of this in his heart will be brought out of the Fire.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ taught us to greet the people of the graves with this.
items.a: Peace be upon you, people of these dwellings

items.q: The spring of Paradise named in Surah al-Insan.
The youths who serve in Paradise and never age.
The record of the righteous is kept in this place.
The one given his record in his left hand will say this (meaning).
items.a: "If only I had not been given my record"

items.q: The plain where people will gather, in the hadith "a white plain like a pure loaf" (paraphrased).
The first to be clothed on the Day of Judgement.
The seven who will be shaded by Allah's shade include a just ruler and this young person.
items.a: A youth who grew up worshipping Allah

items.q: The first matter of worship a servant will be asked about.
The first matter judged between people.
The first Prophet people will go to for intercession, who sends them on.
The Prophet who will finally intercede for all people.
The first person for whom the earth will split open on the Day.
Our Beloved Master ﷺ said, in meaning, that His ﷺ intercession is for the people of these among His ﷺ Ummah.
The light of the believers that runs before them on the Day.
The Day of Judgement is also called "al-Haqqah", "al-Qari'ah" and this "Overwhelming".
The surah that opens "When the sun is wrapped up" (meaning), describing the end.
The surah that describes the earth giving up its burdens.
The surah whose name means "The Calamity that strikes".
The smoke that will cover the people is one of the major signs. Its Arabic name.
The number of major signs listed in the hadith of Hudhayfah ibn Asid (رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ).
The fire at the end that gathers people comes from this land.
The people of Paradise will see Allah, as the moon is seen on this night (meaning).
items.a: The night of the full moon

items.q: The last person to enter Paradise is promised the world and this many times its like.
The name of the people on the heights between Paradise and Hell.
The dead person hears this as the people walk away after burial.
The souls of the martyrs are in the bellies of these, roaming Paradise.
In our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ dream, the children who died young were with this Prophet in a garden.
By Sunni creed, a believer who dies with major sins is not this.
Our master 'Uthman (رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ) wept at graves, saying our Beloved Prophet ﷺ called the grave this.
items.a: The first stage of the Hereafter

items.q: The Throne of the Most Merciful shook at this Companion's death.
People cross the Sirat as fast as their deeds: like the blink of an eye, lightning, wind, birds, and this.
Our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ Pond is as long as this journey.
The cups at His ﷺ Pond are as many as these.
'Isa (عليه السلام) will break the cross, kill the pig, and end this.
"The slave woman will give birth to" this, as a sign of the Hour (meaning).
The fire that "crushes", named in Surah al-Humazah.
The "abyss" in Surah al-Qari'ah.
The record of the wicked is kept in this place.
The spring of Paradise named in Surah al-Mutaffifin, from which the near ones drink.
The drink of the righteous in Surah al-Insan is mixed with this.
The angel who holds the Trumpet, ready to blow (paraphrased).
The questioning of the grave is called this.
After the final tashahhud our Beloved Prophet ﷺ sought refuge from four things: the punishment of Hell, the trial of life and death, the trial of the Dajjal, and this.
The "minor resurrection" is a name for this.
Al-Qurtubi's book on death and the Hereafter.
items.a: al-Tadhkirah bi-Ahwal al-Mawta wa Umur al-Akhirah

items.q: The book of al-Suyuti رحمة الله عليه on the state of the dead in the grave.
The book of al-Ghazali رحمة الله عليه on death and the Hereafter, the last book of the Ihya'.
items.a: Kitab Dhikr al-Mawt wa ma Ba'dahu

items.q: The term for the passing of all creation before the Resurrection.
The verse "Everything upon the earth will perish" (meaning) is in this surah.
The two blowings of the Trumpet: the blast of swooning and this.
Abu Hurayrah (رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ) narrated that the gap between the two blowings is this number, without saying days, months or years.
In Paradise a rider can travel this many years in the shade of one tree.
The lote tree at the farthest boundary.
The House in the seventh heaven visited daily by 70,000 angels.
The two scales of deeds: one with sins and one with this card in the hadith of al-Bitaqah.
items.a: The card of "La ilaha illa Allah"

items.q: The pond of our Beloved Master ﷺ is whiter than milk and sweeter than this.
The first people to cross the Sirat.
items.a: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ and His ﷺ Ummah

items.q: In Sunni creed, the Mizan is described as having these.
Paradise's bricks are of gold and silver, and its mortar is this.
In Paradise there is a market that people visit every this day.
The food of washings from wounds, eaten in the Fire, named in Surah al-Haqqah.
The thorny plant that is food in the Fire, in Surah al-Ghashiyah.
The Dajjal stays 40 days: one like a year, one like a month, one like this, and the rest like ours.
The Mahdi's name, and his father's name, will match these.
items.a: The names of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ and His ﷺ father

items.q: The soul of a believer is "a bird that hangs in the trees of Paradise" (meaning), in this book.
The two angels named in the Qur'an who taught magic in Babylon as a trial.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ told us to remember often "the destroyer of pleasures" (paraphrased), meaning this.
The term for the first sign after which repentance is no longer accepted.
The man the Dajjal will kill and bring back, who will say he is more sure than ever.
The Dajjal will not enter these two cities.
Near the end of time, a man called Dhul-Suwayqatayn will come from this land to harm the Ka'bah.
The Euphrates will uncover a mountain of this.
Ya'juj and Ma'juj will drink dry this lake.
After Ya'juj and Ma'juj, 'Isa (عليه السلام) and the believers will take refuge on this mountain.
The number of earthquakes ("sinkings") among the major signs.
The verse "Do they wait for anything except the Hour" (meaning) mentions its signs have come; the surah.
Our Beloved Master ﷺ said every Prophet has one of these, and His ﷺ will have the most people coming to it (paraphrased).
The station of praise our Beloved Prophet ﷺ is promised.
The banner of praise carried by our Beloved Prophet ﷺ on the Day.
The number of the Ummah who enter Paradise without reckoning, in the hadith.
The Companion who asked to be among the 70,000 and was told "You are one of them" (paraphrased).
The Companion who narrated the hadith of the last man to leave the Fire and enter Paradise.
The surah that begins "The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split" (meaning).
The term for death being brought as a ram and slaughtered between Paradise and Hell.
The Ash'ari creed poem by Ibrahim al-Laqani رحمة الله عليه that lists the Sirat, the Mizan and the Pond.
Al-Suyuti's رحمة الله عليه book on the states of the Hereafter.
Al-Bayhaqi's رحمة الله عليه book on the raising of the dead.
Al-Bajuri's رحمة الله عليه commentary on Jawharat al-Tawhid.
The keeper of Paradise named in some reports.
items.src: Reported in hadith; source to be checked

items.q: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said the grave is either a garden of Paradise or this (paraphrased).
items.src: Sunan al-Tirmidhi; grade to be checked

items.q: The plain on which Allah will gather people is said to be in this land.
The highest people of Paradise will see Allah morning and this.
The wind that takes the soul of every believer near the end blows from this direction, in one narration.
items.src: Sahih Muslim; other narrations name al-Sham

items.q: The day that is fifty thousand years long will feel as short as this for the believer (paraphrased).
items.a: The time of a prescribed prayer
items.src: Musnad Ahmad; grade to be checked
